fn: async () => { /* A1 fresh game: done global false, state empty, no minigame, one task active */ const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; return !window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame && g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === false && g.episode_core_00_first_play_state && Object.keys(g.episode_core_00_first_play_state).length === 0 && Array.isArray(g.se_awareness_records) && g.se_awareness_records.length === 0; }

async () => { /* A2 the runner opens on the brief: scenario variant brief, stage brief, card 1 of 7, Next but no Back, no Got it */ const C = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container; const ep = () => window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState().episode; const head = () => (C.querySelector('.epr-body h1, .epr-body h2, .epr-body h3, .epr-panel h2, .epr-panel h1, .epr-panel h3, h2, h1')||{}).textContent;const e = ep(); const count = C.querySelector('.epr-card-count'); return e.id === 'core_00_first_play' && window.gameScenario.social.awarenessEpisode.variant === 'brief' && e.stage === 'brief' && e.done.length === 0 && !!count && count.textContent === 'Card 1 of 7' && !!C.querySelector('.epr-next') && !C.querySelector('.epr-back') && !C.querySelector('.epr-done') && /practice at Quayholt/.test(C.textContent) && /authorised exercise at Quayholt/i.test(C.textContent); }

async () => { /* A3 Next steps through cards 2 to 7, each with a Back; the stage stays brief and nothing is written */ const C = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container; const ep = () => window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState().episode; const head = () => (C.querySelector('.epr-body h1, .epr-body h2, .epr-body h3, .epr-panel h2, .epr-panel h1, .epr-panel h3, h2, h1')||{}).textContent;const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; const seen = []; for (let n = 2; n <= 7; n++) { const b = C.querySelector('.epr-next'); if (!b) return { fail: 'no Next before card '+n }; b.click(); await sleep(80); const cnt = C.querySelector('.epr-card-count'); if (!cnt || cnt.textContent !== 'Card '+n+' of 7') return { fail: 'count at '+n+': '+(cnt&&cnt.textContent) }; if (!C.querySelector('.epr-back')) return { fail: 'no Back at '+n }; seen.push(C.querySelector('.epr-text').textContent.length); } const last = !C.querySelector('.epr-next') && !!C.querySelector('.epr-done') && C.querySelector('.epr-done').textContent === 'Got it'; return last && ep().stage === 'brief' && ep().done.length === 0 && g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === false && seen.length === 6; }

async () => { /* A4 Back returns to card 6 and shows its text (the habit to keep, the shared rule of thumb), Next returns to 7 */ const C = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container; const ep = () => window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState().episode; const head = () => (C.querySelector('.epr-body h1, .epr-body h2, .epr-body h3, .epr-panel h2, .epr-panel h1, .epr-panel h3, h2, h1')||{}).textContent;const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); C.querySelector('.epr-back').click(); await sleep(80); const cnt = C.querySelector('.epr-card-count').textContent; const t6 = C.textContent; C.querySelector('.epr-next').click(); await sleep(80); return cnt === 'Card 6 of 7' && /The habit to keep/.test(t6) && /Report, and no blame/.test(C.textContent) && !!C.querySelector('.epr-done'); }

async () => { /* A5 Got it completes the brief: done global true, state written, the runner shows Finished */ const C = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container; const ep = () => window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState().episode; const head = () => (C.querySelector('.epr-body h1, .epr-body h2, .epr-body h3, .epr-panel h2, .epr-panel h1, .epr-panel h3, h2, h1')||{}).textContent;const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); C.querySelector('.epr-done').click(); await sleep(300); const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; const st = g.episode_core_00_first_play_state; const fin = C.querySelector('.epr-finished'); return g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === true && st && typeof st === 'object' && Object.keys(st).length > 0 && !!fin && /finished/i.test(fin.textContent); }

async () => { /* A6 the mission task completes through the host mapping and the success screen can show */ const t = window.__test; const s = t.getState(); const g = s.globals; const o = JSON.stringify(s.objectives || window.gameState.objectives || window.objectivesManager?.aims || {}); return g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === true && /complete_brief/.test(o); }

async () => { /* B0 close: the runner is closed, done stays true, the record count is kept for the reload check */ const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; return !window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame && g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === true && g.se_awareness_records.length === 0; }
async () => { window.__preReload = true; setTimeout(() => location.assign(location.pathname + "?skip_resume=1"), 50); return true; }

async () => { /* C1 the page reloaded and the game is ready */ const t0 = Date.now(); while (!(window.__test && window.__test.waitUntilReady) && Date.now() - t0 < 60000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); if (window.__preReload) return false; const r = await window.__test.waitUntilReady({ timeoutMs: 60000 }); return !!(r && r.ok); }

async () => { /* C2 after the reload the done global and the state are still set, nothing else was added */ const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; return g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === true && Object.keys(g.episode_core_00_first_play_state).length > 0 && g.se_awareness_records.length === 0; }

async () => { /* C3 reopened: the already-seen panel shows, no brief card, no Next or Got it, nothing new written */ const C = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container; const ep = () => window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState().episode; const head = () => (C.querySelector('.epr-body h1, .epr-body h2, .epr-body h3, .epr-panel h2, .epr-panel h1, .epr-panel h3, h2, h1')||{}).textContent;const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; const f = C.querySelector('.epr-finished'); return !!f && /already/.test(f.textContent) && /Start your first episode whenever you are ready/.test(f.textContent) && !C.querySelector('.epr-card-count') && !C.querySelector('.epr-next') && !C.querySelector('.epr-done') && g.episode_core_00_first_play_done === true && g.se_awareness_records.length === 0; }
